title: Antique Brass Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Allied Brass
description: Add organized storage to your bath or shower with this 18.75-inch wall-mounted shower basket. Available in Antique Brass. Antique Brass features a softened, aged golden patina. The oval combination caddy provides a secure place for shampoo, conditioner, soap, and daily essentials while the ventilated, heavy-gauge solid brass wires promote drainage and will never rust.
